payload.title: Prime the production relevance cyclotron from a pasted URL
payload.description: As a production editor, I want to paste a URL and a label into the References view, so that the next relevance sweep primes the running cyclotron with it (Cyclotron add_priming_examples) without a new store. Request channel mirrors the review-rate request: KnowledgeRawPayload kind cyclotron-priming-request.
